message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta. The city’s noise ordinance is enforced by the **Atlanta Police Department** and the **City Code‑Enforcement Office**. ### How to file a complaint | Method | Contact details | Notes | |--------|-----------------|-------| | **Phone (non‑emergency)** | 404‑656‑4000 | Call during business hours (Mon‑Fri 8 a.m.–5 p.m.) and ask to be directed to the Noise‑Complaint line. | | **Online form** | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ | Search “Noise Complaint” on the site; you’ll find a PDF form you can fill out and email or fax. | | **Mail / Fax** | City Hall, 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303
Fax: 404‑656‑4000 | Mail or fax the completed form to the City Hall address. | | **Email** | noisecomplaint@atlantaga.gov | Attach a copy of the completed form and any supporting evidence (photos, videos, dates, times). | ### What to include 1. **Your contact information** (name, address, phone, email). 2. **Location of the noise source** (street address or intersection). 3. **Date(s) and time(s)** when the noise occurred. 4. **Description of the noise** (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 5. **Any evidence** (audio/video recordings, photos). 6. **Any prior attempts** to resolve the issue (e.g., talking to the neighbor, calling the police). ### After filing - The city will review your complaint and may contact you for additional details. - If the complaint is valid, the police or code‑enforcement officer will investigate and issue a citation or warning if necessary. - You can track the status of your complaint by calling the non‑emergency line or checking the city’s online portal. ### Quick links - **City of Atlanta official website**: https://www.atlantaga.gov - **Noise ordinance text** (City Code § 10‑1‑1): https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2023-09/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf - **Police Department – Traffic & Noise**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/police/traffic-and-noise Feel free to use any of these methods to report a noise disturbance. The city takes noise complaints seriously and will act to enforce its ordinance.
